description: A unified ingestion API for data partners, agencies and advertisers to connect first-party data across Google advertising products.
name: datamanager
title: Data Manager API

CompositeData.description: Composite data holding identifiers and associated data for a user. At least one of `user_data` or `ip_data` is required.

ipData.description: Optional. IP address data representing customer interaction used to build the audience.

userData.description: Optional. User-provided data that identifies the user.

wipProvider.description: Required. The [Workload Identity](//cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workload-identity-federation) pool provider required to use KEK.

costMicros.description: Optional. The cost associated with the model, in micro units (10^-6), in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`.

startTime.description: Output only. Start time of the pricing.

endTime.description: Optional. End time of the pricing.

maxCostMicros.description: Optional. The maximum CPM a commerce audience can be charged when the MEDIA_SHARE cost type is used. The value is in micro units (10^-6) and in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`. This is only relevant when cost_type is MEDIA_SHARE. When cost_type is not MEDIA_SHARE, and this field is set, a MAX_COST_NOT_ALLOWED error will be returned. If not set or set to`0`, there is no cap.

pricingId.description: Output only. The ID of this pricing.

buyerApprovalState.description: Output only. The buyer approval state of this pricing. This field is read-only.

User list client has accepted the pricing terms set by the user list owner.
User list client has rejected the pricing terms set by the user list owner.

currencyCode.description: Optional. The currency in which cost and max_cost is specified. Must be a three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

pricingActive.description: Output only. Whether this pricing is active.

enumDescriptions: Unspecified product. Should never be used.

validateOnly.description: Optional. For testing purposes. If `true`, the request is validated but not executed. Only errors are returned, not results.

encoding.description: Optional. Required for UserData uploads. The encoding type of the user identifiers. Applies to only the outer encoding for encrypted user identifiers. For non `UserData` uploads, this field is ignored.

viewabilityInfo.description: Required. Details of the viewability of the ad served.

timestamp.description: Required. The time the event occurred.

deviceInfo.description: Optional. Information gathered about the device being used when the ad event happened.

mobileDeviceId.description: Optional. The device ID of the device that the ad was served to.

medium.description: Required. The medium of the ad, akin to the Google Analytics medium.

adId.description: Optional. The ID of the associated ad within the group.

userData.description: Optional. Multiple pieces of user-provided data, representing the user the event is associated with. It is possible to provide multiple instances of the same type of data (e.g. email address). The more data provided, the more likely a match will be found.

campaignName.description: Required. The name of the associated campaign.

regionCode.description: Required. The ISO 3166-2 country plus subdivision.

adWidth.description: Optional. The width of the ad in pixels.

source.description: Required. The platform source of the ad, akin to the Google Analytics source.

advertiserId.description: Required. The ID of the advertiser for the ad event. This must match the ID sent in the linking flow.

campaignId.description: Required. The ID of the associated campaign.

adHeight.description: Optional. The height of the ad in pixels.

The user ID cannot be found for the given impression ID.

UserListLicenseMetrics.description: Metrics related to a user list license.

clickCount.description: Output only. The number of clicks for the user list license.

startDate.description: Output only. The start date (inclusive) of the metrics in the format YYYYMMDD. For example, 20260102 represents January 2, 2026. If `end_date` is used in the filter, `start_date` is also required. If neither `start_date` nor `end_date` are included in the filter, the UserListLicenseMetrics fields will not be populated in the response.

revenueUsdMicros.description: Output only. The revenue for the user list license in USD micros.

impressionCount.description: Output only. The number of impressions for the user list license.

endDate.description: Output only. The end date (inclusive) of the metrics in the format YYYYMMDD. For example, 20260102 represents January 2, 2026. If `start_date` is used in the filter, `end_date` is also required. If neither `start_date` nor `end_date` are included in the filter, the UserListLicenseMetrics fields will not be populated in the response.

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

merchantFeedLabel.description: Optional. The feed label of the Merchant Center feed. If countries are still being used, the 2-letter country code in ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 can be used instead. For Store Sales events this will override the value set at the cart level. This field is ignored for other events.

itemId.description: Optional. A unique identifier to reference the item.

merchantFeedLanguageCode.description: Optional. The language code in ISO 639-1 associated with the Merchant Center feed where your items are uploaded.

For encrypted hashed user identifiers, this is the encoding type of the outer encrypted string, but not necessarily the inner hashed string, meaning the inner hashed string could be encoded in a different way than the outer encrypted string. For non `UserData` uploads, this field is ignored.
